_note: Evaluation system profiles. A profile = one cluster (clusters.json) + a subset of memories (memories_default.json). Values are NOT redefined here; they come from the two config files, so provenance tags (SPEC/PUBLIC/ASSUMED) live there. Human-readable spec: doc-mk/Evaluation/system-specs.md | 2026-10-03: primary set = generation profiles (SYS-A100/H100/B200/VR): all six memory kinds present, differing by GENERATION (GPU/HBM, host link, DRAM, SSD). SYS-1..5 are legacy memory-subset ablations (kept unchanged).

SYS-A100.name: A100x8 (Ampere-class): HBM2e + PCIe4 + DDR4 + six memory kinds
SYS-A100.purpose: Previous-generation platform with all six memory kinds. Emerging memories are attached via PCIe 4.0 (hypothetical: CXL needs PCIe 5.0+).

generation.cxl: n/a on platform (ASSUMED behind PCIe4-rate link)

link.name: PCIe 4.0 x16 (31.5 GB/s)
link.provenance: SPEC: PCIe 4.0 = 16 GT/s, 128b/130b, x16 ~ 31.5 GB/s per direction (half of PCIe 5.0). ext_bw_scale is relative to the PCIe 5.0 x16 baseline (63.0 GB/s) in memories_default.json; ASSUMED: applied uniformly to every host-link-bound tier (cHBM, CXL-PNM, DRAM ext, SSD-PIM ext). HBF (GPU-reachable, UCIe) is not link-scaled.

dram.provenance: DDR4-3200 25.6 GB/s/ch x8ch = 204.8 GB/s, rounded to 200 GB/s with the same convention as the 400 GB/s DDR5 baseline (SPEC math, host config ASSUMED). Ext follows PCIe 4.0.

cxl_pnm.provenance_append: A100 platform has no CXL (PCIe 4.0 host). ASSUMED hypothetical: the CXL-PNM device sits behind a PCIe 4.0 x16-rate link (x0.5). Internal BW unchanged (LPDDR5X media).

SYS-A100.emerging_scaling_note: ASSUMED: emerging devices (custom_hbm, cxl_pnm, hbf, ssd_pim) have no past generations; the same device is used on every platform and only its host-link-bound external BW is scaled (link-bound scaling). Internal BW/compute/latency fixed (cHBM follows the paired-GPU rule).

SYS-H100.name: H100x8 (Hopper-class): HBM3 + PCIe5 + DDR5-4800 + six memory kinds
SYS-H100.purpose: Hopper platform: HBM3 (not HBM3e), PCIe 5.0, CXL 2.0-capable host.

link.name: PCIe 5.0 x16 (63.0 GB/s)
link.provenance: SPEC: PCIe 5.0 = 32 GT/s, 128b/130b, x16 ~ 63.0 GB/s (same as the memories_default.json baseline); CXL 2.0 runs on the PCIe 5.0 PHY. ext_bw_scale is relative to the PCIe 5.0 x16 baseline (63.0 GB/s) in memories_default.json; ASSUMED: applied uniformly to every host-link-bound tier (cHBM, CXL-PNM, DRAM ext, SSD-PIM ext). HBF (GPU-reachable, UCIe) is not link-scaled.

dram.provenance: DDR5-4800 38.4 GB/s/ch x8ch = 307 GB/s, rounded to 300 GB/s (SPEC math, host config ASSUMED). Ext follows PCIe 5.0.

SYS-H100.emerging_scaling_note: ASSUMED: emerging devices (custom_hbm, cxl_pnm, hbf, ssd_pim) have no past generations; the same device is used on every platform and only its host-link-bound external BW is scaled (link-bound scaling). Internal BW/compute/latency fixed (cHBM follows the paired-GPU rule).

SYS-B200.name: B200x8 (Blackwell-class): HBM3e + PCIe5 + DDR5-6400 + six memory kinds
SYS-B200.purpose: Blackwell platform, all six memory kinds. Numerically identical to legacy SYS-4 (verified field by field in tests).

link.name: PCIe 5.0 x16 (63.0 GB/s)
link.provenance: SPEC: PCIe 5.0 x16 ~ 63.0 GB/s; CXL 2.0 on PCIe 5.0 PHY. ext_bw_scale is relative to the PCIe 5.0 x16 baseline (63.0 GB/s) in memories_default.json; ASSUMED: applied uniformly to every host-link-bound tier (cHBM, CXL-PNM, DRAM ext, SSD-PIM ext). HBF (GPU-reachable, UCIe) is not link-scaled.

SYS-B200.emerging_scaling_note: ASSUMED: emerging devices (custom_hbm, cxl_pnm, hbf, ssd_pim) have no past generations; the same device is used on every platform and only its host-link-bound external BW is scaled (link-bound scaling). Internal BW/compute/latency fixed (cHBM follows the paired-GPU rule).

SYS-VR.name: Vera Rubin x8 (Rubin-class): HBM4 + PCIe6 + DDR5-6400 + six memory kinds
SYS-VR.purpose: Next-generation platform: HBM4 (384 GB, 28 TB/s), PCIe 6.0 / CXL 3.x. Same as legacy SYS-5 except host-link BW x2 (PCIe 6.0) on link-bound tiers.

link.name: PCIe 6.0 x16 (126 GB/s)
link.provenance: SPEC: PCIe 6.0 = 64 GT/s PAM4, x16 ~ 126 GB/s raw (flit/FEC overhead not deducted, ASSUMED); CXL 3.x on PCIe 6.0 PHY. ext_bw_scale is relative to the PCIe 5.0 x16 baseline (63.0 GB/s) in memories_default.json; ASSUMED: applied uniformly to every host-link-bound tier (cHBM, CXL-PNM, DRAM ext, SSD-PIM ext). HBF (GPU-reachable, UCIe) is not link-scaled.

SYS-VR.emerging_scaling_note: ASSUMED: emerging devices (custom_hbm, cxl_pnm, hbf, ssd_pim) have no past generations; the same device is used on every platform and only its host-link-bound external BW is scaled (link-bound scaling). Internal BW/compute/latency fixed (cHBM follows the paired-GPU rule).

SYS-1.name: B200x8 + host DRAM (As-Is class)
SYS-1.purpose: Today's vLLM-class hierarchy (HBM + CPU DRAM). Lower bound for heterogeneity benefit.

SYS-2.name: B200x8 + DRAM + CXL-PNM
SYS-2.purpose: Adds a capacity tier with near-memory attention (host-staged).

SYS-3.name: B200x8 + DRAM + HBF
SYS-3.purpose: Adds a GPU-reachable high-BW / high-latency / write-limited tier.

SYS-5.name: Vera Rubin x8 + all six memories
SYS-5.purpose: Next-gen GPU (HBM4, 384 GB, 28 TB/s) with the same memory set; cHBM scales with the paired GPU.
